subject: Marketplace acceptance: phased cutover & invoice handoff
messages:
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliomed.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace acceptance: phased cutover & invoice handoff

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call, HelioMed is proceeding with the 18‑month commitment but wants to accept the AWS Private Offer in two tranches (Q3 acceptance for baseline capacity, Q1 next year for the uplift). To make this clean for both billing and AWS invoicing, I propose the handshake below: 

1) Redwood will prepare an AWS PO amendment that explicitly calls out the staged acceptance dates and the committed qps uplift schedule.
2) HelioMed procurement signs tranche 1 now (baseline quantity) via DocuSign; tranche 2 will be signed as a separate acceptance form when package+usage forecast is confirmed (target Jan 15, 2028).
3) Invoices: Redwood will issue two separate invoice references tied to the two acceptances so your AP team can map them to the correct fiscal periods.
4) Ops/Onboarding: we'll freeze a window for the cutover for tranche 1 (target Sep 1) and include acceptance test checkboxes in the DocuSign form.

I've attached a draft amendment and an acceptance checklist for your procurement and AP to review. If this approach looks right, we can generate the DocuSign envelope and loop in your procurement mailbox.

Next steps I need from HelioMed:
- Confirmation that two-tranche acceptance is acceptable to AP/legal
- Primary PO/PO number for tranche 1 so we can reference it in the amendment

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
[Attachment: HelioMed_AWS_PO_Amendment_v2.pdf]
[Attachment: Redwood-acceptance-checklist.xlsx]

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliomed.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com, samir.raza@cloud-reseller.io
Date: 2027-08-07T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace acceptance: phased cutover & invoice handoff

Thanks Rishi — this mirrors what we discussed. Procurement is comfortable with the two-tranche acceptance in principle, but AP needs the invoices to be clearly tagged to fiscal buckets. A couple quick items: 

- Can the amendment call out invoice reference codes (e.g., HM-Q3-27-T1 and HM-Q1-28-T2)? AP insists on a clear mapping.
- For tranche 2, we will need a short usage forecast template so our FinOps team can justify the uplift in Q1.

I'll loop in procurement and Samir (our cloud reseller) to make sure marketplace billing flows properly to our contract. Please send the DocuSign and include the checklist.

Elena
VP, Platform & Ops
HelioMed
[Attachment: procurement_fiscal_requirements.pdf]

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliomed.com>
Date: 2027-08-07T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace acceptance: phased cutover & invoice handoff

Looping in some legal/ops notes for the amendment. Rishi — see inline suggestions: please add the invoice reference code fields and a clause that the second-tranche acceptance form can be executed no earlier than 90 days prior to the planned uplift window (gives us runway for capacity planning).

Also adding a DocuSign note: use separate envelopes for each tranche to avoid mixing signatures across fiscal periods. We can host the acceptance checklist as part of the envelope so AP can download a signed copy.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: DocuSign-HelioMed-PO-link.txt]

From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliomed.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com
Date: 2027-08-08T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace acceptance: phased cutover & invoice handoff

Elena — quick operational note from Dedicated/Dedicated-to-PO teams: for tranche 1 we can provision the baseline pool under the existing dedicated SKU. For tranche 2 uplift, we recommend a 2-week freeze window before activation to run acceptance tests (KV warm-up, prefix cache priming).

If HelioMed prefers, we can add a short runbook to the acceptance checklist that walking your SREs through the activation steps so the uplift is non-disruptive.

I'll also map expected token burn ranges based on your forecast once you share it (helps with invoice estimate).

— Priyom
Principal Product Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliomed.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@heliomed.com, samir.raza@cloud-reseller.io
Date: 2027-08-09T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace acceptance: phased cutover & invoice handoff

All — procurement reviewed the draft and approved the two-envelope approach IF you add the invoice reference codes (we provided the PO number in the thread). We attach the PO and a short forecast template — Samir will co-sign the reseller acceptance for tranche 1. 

A few closing items before we sign: 
- Rishi: please issue the DocuSign envelope for tranche 1 with reference code HM-Q3-27-T1 and include the acceptance checklist.
- Kimberly: confirm the 90-day execution window clause is in the amendment.
- Priyom: share the short runbook with Samir and our SREs; we'll schedule the 2-week freeze window for Aug 30 — Sep 13.

If we can have the envelope by end of day tomorrow, procurement will route for signature and we can meet your Sep 1 target for cutover.

Thanks —
Elena
VP, Platform & Ops, HelioMed
[Attachment: HelioMed_PO_20482.pdf]
